user.title: AlarmeHA
user.description: One entry per person/phone. Pick the Companion app notify service of that phone.

pair.title: Pair the phone
pair.description:
1. On the phone, open AlarmeHA: Settings → Home Assistant → Pairing and token → **Scan QR code**.

{qr}

No camera? Copy the text below to the phone and use **Paste configuration**:

`{pairing}`

2. The app shows the token only once: tap **Copy token** and paste it below.

error.invalid_token: Invalid token: copy it from the AlarmeHA app

abort.no_mobile_app: No notify.mobile_app_* service found. Install and set up the Companion app on the phone.
